stem: With which statement would the author most likely agree?

options.label: A
options.text: Millan has a special talent for dealing with all kinds of dogs.

options.label: B
options.text: Millan understands that some dogs are too difficult to train.

options.label: C
options.text: Millan is disappointed that he was not able to train dogs for the movies.

options.label: D
options.text: Millan wants to give all people the chance to own a dog of their own.
